text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (date of the order) for 2515 Lake Shore Boulevard West

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Amended the Required Action Section, under By-law Section 23.F.(2), for the Property Standards Order (October 3, 2024) for 2515 Lake Shore Boulevard West, Folder Number: 23 210107 PRS 00 IV to read as follows: "Namely: Repair the surface of the parking lot to create a level surface, and such work to be done in a workperson-like manner." 2. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (October 3, 2024) as amended by Part 1 above, for 2515 Lake Shore Boulevard West, Folder Number: 23 210107 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to August 30, 2024.
